dedupe_keys.name: sdg e outage potential index experimental

description: SDG&E Outage Potential Index (Experimental) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Outage prediction tool that correlates historical weather data, weather forecast output from the GFS 003 WRF model, and historical outage data to create a 96-hour forecast predicting the potential for weather-related outages and the corresponding number of customers potentially impacted in each of SDG&E’s eight operating districts. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity, Weather, Outage. Its keywords are severe weather outlook, electricity outages, resilience, electric power failures. The portal shows 2025-08-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is SDG&E License (https://sdge.sdsc.edu/SDGE-LICENSE). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
